integrity: Full linear-algebra bijection, two finite-subspace Möbius inversions, explicit finite-field formulas and exhaustive small-field tests; no independent review.
scientific_limitations: Labeled ordered commuting square-zero factors; excludes higher nilpotency and similarity orbits. Qualitative image characterization, zero-product double-flag count and four-dimensional fiber formula are existing results and credited. Priority against unidentified all-dimensional factor-count literature remains provisional.
title: Complete finite-field product fibers for pairs of commuting square-zero matrices
